content.short: LedgerMail is a blockchain-based, next-generation email system focused on secure and private communication.
content.description: LedgerMail is a blockchain-based, next-generation email system that does not rely on legacy protocols such as SMTP or IMAP. It uses its own proprietary technology to enhance security and reliability beyond traditional email. The system operates as a closed-loop network, sending and receiving messages entirely within the LedgerMail environment to protect privacy and prevent exposure to unsecured third-party networks. It also integrates with a range of popular services and applications, making it easier to use and manage within a Web3 communications workflow.
content.meta: LedgerMail is an infrastructure platform. Discover LedgerMail and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Email Where the Server Holds No Keys
resources.tldr: Each message is a validated transaction and decryption keys stay with the user, so the provider cannot read the mailbox.

resources.title: How the System Was Built
resources.tldr: Running on XDC with delegated proof of stake, plus sign-in through ENS and Unstoppable Domains rather than an address.
